title: Binance Adds AGLD, T on Cross Margin & New ARKM, AUCTION Isolated Margin Pairs
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance has added   AGLD and T  as new  borrowable assets  on  Cross   Margin,  as well as new trading pairs on  Isolated Margin : New Cross Margin Pairs:   AGLD/USDT ,  T/USDT New Isolated Margin Pairs:  ARKM/TUSD ,  AUCTION/USDT Explore Binance Margin Now! Notes: Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail.
